limitations: This verifies existing artifacts only; no model training, notebook execution, inference, confirmation or submission occurs.
Checkpoint fingerprints and explicit group complements corroborate recorded training scope; saved metadata cannot independently prove the historical optimization consumed only the attested data.
Input scaler counts and pressure-label fingerprints are checked, but 47-feature input statistics are not independently recomputed.

Trusted local .pt checkpoints are deserialized with torch.load(weights_only=False); residual LightGBM pickle is SHA256 checked but never unpickled, so its internal metadata/model parameters are not inspected.
The original A screen is reused for selection and is not an unbiased estimate; only the best eligible candidate from a complete batch may proceed to separately authorized frozen grouped confirmation.

hash_conventions.candidate_predictions_and_row_ids: SHA256 raw contiguous ndarray bytes; no shape/dtype prefix
hash_conventions.residual_manifest_groups: SHA256 sorted int64 little-endian raw bytes
hash_conventions.residual_manifest_rows: SHA256 canonical-order int64 little-endian raw bytes
hash_conventions.residual_manifest_json: SHA256 sorted compact JSON; separators comma/colon
hash_conventions.design_identity: SHA256 sorted JSON with default separators
